blocks.text: Managing multiple AMC portals in Chrome

Appraisers often juggle several AMC portals at once. Keeping them open in one window creates clutter. Use Chrome Profiles to create a dedicated space for your appraisal work. Go to the profile icon in the top right corner of Chrome. Select Add to create a new profile. Name it Appraisal Work. This keeps your work cookies and history separate from your personal life. It also keeps your saved passwords for different portals organized.

items: ⌘ + T: Open a new tab for your next property search.
⌘ + L: Jump directly to the address bar to type a new URL.
⌘ + Option + Right Arrow: Quickly switch to the next open tab.
⌘ + 1 through 8: Jump to a specific tab number.
⌘ + F: Find specific text on a long page of public records.

blocks.text: Clearing site data for faster performance

Sometimes a portal will stop loading correctly. This often happens because of old cache or cookies. You do not need to clear everything. You can clear data for just one site. Click the settings icon in the address bar. Choose Site Settings. Go to Usage and click Clear Data. This fixes most connection errors without logging you out of every other site.
Researching comparable sales on your Mac

Collecting comps is the most time-consuming part of your day. Start by organizing your bookmarks. Use the Bookmarks Bar for your most used MLS sites and county record databases. Press ⌘ + Option + B to open the Bookmark Manager if you need to reorganize folders. Keeping your research links in one place saves you from searching for them every morning.

If you find yourself constantly typing the same phrases for email responses, use the text expansion features in macOS. Go to System Settings > Keyboard > Text Replacements. Create a shortcut like 'addr' that expands to your full office address.

blocks.text: Using Lazur with your Chrome workflow

Lazur works in the background while you use Chrome. Hold ⌥ ⌘ to ask Lazur about a specific portal error. It can explain what a setting does or point you to where a button is located. If you are drafting a status update email, hold the fn key to dictate your notes directly into the text box. This keeps your hands on the keyboard and your focus on the screen.

If you see the Aw Snap error, it means the page crashed. First, try refreshing the page with ⌘ + R. If that fails, check your extensions. Some extensions interfere with site scripts. Go to Chrome > Settings > Extensions and toggle them off one by one to see if the site loads. If you have many extensions, keep only the ones you use daily for appraisal work.

faq.question: Can I use Chrome on older macOS versions?
faq.answer: Current versions of Chrome require macOS 13 Ventura or later. If you are on an older system, you will not receive the latest security updates.

faq.question: How do I stop notifications from AMC portals?
faq.answer: Go to Chrome settings, search for Notifications, and remove the specific portal from the Allow list.

faq.question: Does Lazur work inside Chrome?
faq.answer: Yes. Lazur sees your screen and helps you navigate or dictate text in any browser window, including Chrome.
